Hi there,

I'm Rachel, and I'll be your Business Analyst for the ChefMate Recipe App project. I'll be working closely with you to turn your idea into a clear plan that the rest of the team can build from. My goal is to ask some questions to help us understand the project requirements, so we can create a solid foundation for the app.

Before we dive in, I just want to make sure we're on the same page. Can you mind if I ask a few questions to get started?
